using System;

using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class ItchIntegrationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void GetPlayerName_WithNoApiKey_DoesNotInvokeCallback()
        {
            // Arrange
            var callback = new Mock<Action<string>>();
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", null);
            
            var integration = new ItchIntegration();

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback.Object);

            // Assert
            callback.Verify(c => c(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetPlayerName_WithApiKeyAndSuccessfulResponse_InvokesCallbackWithDisplayName()
        {
            // Arrange
            var apiKey = "test-api-key";
            Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("ITCHIO_API_KEY", apiKey);

            var mockHttpMessageHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
            var response = new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                Content = new StringContent(@"{""user"":{""display_name"":""TestDisplayName"",""username"":""testuser""}}")
            };
            mockHttpMessageHandler
                .Setup(h => h.SendAsync(It.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync(response);

            var mockHttpClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpMessageHandler.Object);
            var mockHttpClientFactory = new Mock<Func<HttpClient>>();
            mockHttpClientFactory.Setup(f => f()).Returns(mockHttpClient);

            // Use reflection to inject mock HttpClientFactory since it's static
            var field = typeof(ItchIntegration).Assembly.GetType("OpenRA.Mods.Common.HttpClientFactory")?
                .GetField("create", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            field?.SetValue(null, mockHttpClientFactory.Object);

            var integration = new ItchIntegration();
            var callbackTcs = new TaskCompletionSource<string>();
            void callback(string name) => callbackTcs.SetResult(name);

            // Act
            integration.GetPlayerName(callback);
            var result = await callbackTcs.Task;

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal("TestDisplayName", result);
        }

        public async Task GetPlayerName_WithApiKeyAndNoDisplayName_InvokesCallbackWithUsername()
